name: Bushkill Outreach
hero_alt: Completed Bushkill Outreach building and parking lot
paragraphs: Bushkill Outreach was a ground-up construction project we carried from foundation to finish throughout 2024. Our team's involvement started with concrete flatwork and a below-grade concrete tank structure in June, followed by the building's wood-frame shell and roof trusses by mid-July.

By August, our masons were installing stone veneer along the building's foundation walls while framing continued above, and by November the structure stood substantially complete — sided, roofed, and ready for final site work.
The finished building now serves as a home base for community outreach in the Bushkill area, and the photos below trace its progress from a poured slab to a fully landscaped, move-in-ready facility.
summary: Ground-up construction of a new community outreach building, completed 2024.
